update_config: update an existing accelerate config file with the latest defaults while maintaining the old configuration
update_config_command: run the accelerate config update command to refresh a config file with new defaults
update_command_parser: build an argparse subcommand parser for the accelerate config update CLI command
summarize_update_config: summarize the update_config function that loads, refreshes, and writes back an accelerate config file
review_update_config_file: review the accelerate config update module for maintaining backward compatibility with existing configs
